mcp:tool-listener.name: runCreditCheck
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Run internal credit decisioning for onboarding.

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var requestedExposure = payload.requestedExposure default {} var exposure = requestedExposure.amount default 0 var currency = requestedExposure.currency default "USD" var score = if (exposure <= 1000000) 780 else if (exposure <= 3000000) 740 else if (exposure <= 5000000) 690 else if (exposure <= 8000000) 630 else 560 var decisionBand = if (score >= 720) "APPROVE" else if (score >= 620) "REVIEW" else "DECLINE" --- { status: if (exposure <= 0) "INCONCLUSIVE" else if (decisionBand == "DECLINE") "FAIL" else "PASS", decisionBand: if (exposure <= 0) "REVIEW" else decisionBand, creditScore: score, approvedLimit: { currency: currency, amount: if (exposure <= 0) 0 else if (decisionBand == "APPROVE") exposure else if (decisionBand == "REVIEW") (exposure * 0.7) else 0 }, requiresHitl: exposure > 5000000 or decisionBand == "REVIEW", reasons: if (exposure <= 0) ["Missing or invalid requestedExposure.amount"] else if (decisionBand == "APPROVE") ["Credit profile within policy threshold"] else if (decisionBand == "REVIEW") ["Manual underwriter review required for exposure or medium risk profile"] else ["Credit profile below underwriting threshold"], checkId: "CRD-" ++ (now() as String {format: "yyyyMMddHHmmss"}), checkedAt: now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssXXX"}, sourceRef: vars.correlationId }
